This is uppermost in my mind definitely since the pandemic disrupted classes in March. Even earlier, given #ClimateChange scenarios, I’ve been trying to prep students for a potentially v uncertain, dynamic future. Thus focus on systems thinking, adaptability, student resilience.

Give all the Black people in your life/work at least a day off. Damn the USA is so steeped in white supremacy, it is hard to even watch as an "outsider" immigrant. Black people need a break to care for themselves, y'all!
